reviewed_by: Codex unsent new-chat draft lifecycle review
reason: The Assistant composer now keeps an immediate in-memory draft per project and conversation while retaining sessionStorage recovery. Four focused frontend cases cover denied browser storage, isolation, explicit clearing, and the exact New Chat to saved conversation to New Chat journey. Eight catalogued conversation-switching entries cover desktop Chromium plus 320, 390, and 430 px emulated Chromium and WebKit profiles.
exclusions: No Python, Rust, backend, provider, harness, streaming, or unrelated browser tests: the change is limited to device-local unsent composer state and its conversation identity boundary. The selected browser journey is mocked because no Core mutation should occur before the first message is sent. Production build is checked separately. Physical-device coverage is unavailable and is not inferred from emulation.
